description: This trail branches off of Silverton Creek Trail. Takes you up to smaller lakes at an elevation of +/- 1986 m. Then beyond that the Wilfred Ridge and Titei Mountain with an elevation of +/- 2560m.
directions: From the bridge on Highway 6, in Silverton, travel south one block. Turn left onto 4th Street, then left onto Alpha Street. Follow Alpha Street as it turns into gravel on the "Four Mile Creek Road" and the "Silverton Creek Forest Service Road". Follow this road, staying along the valley bottom, on the left side of the creek. At about 9.5 km the road forks, stay left. At about 12.5 the road forks, stay left. Continue on this road another 3 km to the trailhead. Note: this road tends to wash out between the 9 and 10 km markers. Up to that point, it is passable in a 2 wheel drive vehicle. This will get to the trail Silverton Creek Trail Head and about +/- 560m hike to the trail heading Eastward.
title: Billy Valentine Trail
